correctness.rationale: Loopless radical-square-zero A=kQ/J² has derivations fixing idempotents represented by arbitrary matrices on each parallel-arrow class; quotient by inner derivations is precisely the central vertex-potential scalar subspace U. Restricted p^e power of a representative is componentwise M_alpha^(p^e). If it is central U, the unique p^e roots in a perfect field yield a unique gauge representative N_alpha with N_alpha^(p^e)=0. Jordan orbit partitions lambda_1<=p^e yield product q-point formula; dominance maximal partition (h^a,r) yields reduced irreducibility and dimension m²-r(a+1)²-(h-r)a². Direct independently enumerated GF(2) matrix examples N²=0: 2x2 count 4 and 3x3 count 22; N⁴=0: 3x3 count 64. Perfectness, looplessness, reduced geometry and height e>=1 essential. These bounded samples do not prove arbitrary quivers.
